description:
About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

The Role

OpenRouter now has a competitive offering for image, video, and audio generation, but we're newer to the space. Most developers still think of OpenRouter as an LLM-only router.

We're looking for a Developer Relations lead for multimodal to change that. You'll build brand association, show developers they can run their media workloads on OpenRouter, and make every new image, video, and audio launch the moment they try it here first.


What You'll Do

  • Run day-0 media launches. Ship same-day demos, starter code, and social posts whenever a new image, video, or audio model drops, so developers try it on OpenRouter first.

  • Publish cookbooks and guides. Build inspirational and practical examples that combine models and modalities into compelling media, including how agents and apps can use OpenRouter to add media capabilities.

  • Drive search and AEO visibility. Write content and promote our media benchmarks so search engines and coding agents recommend OpenRouter for media generation.

  • Show up in the community. Be where media builders are, run community events, co-market with labs like ElevenLabs and Black Forest Labs, and bring developer feedback back to engineering.

  • Work cross-functionally. Partner with our Community Lead, marketing, and events teams so launches, content, and community moments reinforce each other.

What Success Looks Like

  • Self-serve adoption. Better launches and content bring in a broader base of builders who care about media generation.

  • Enterprise credibility. Enterprises in the creative space see OpenRouter as a safe, long-term partner.

  • Cross-sell to LLM users. Our existing text developers add image, video, and voice to their apps without leaving OpenRouter.

  • Organic discovery. Builders and coding agents searching for speech, transcription, image, and video APIs find OpenRouter first.

  • Stronger lab partnerships. Loud, high-converting launches give model providers a reason to bring us early access and exclusive variants.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience building with image, video, or audio generation models and their APIs. This space is new, so we care about what you've shipped, not years of experience.

  • A developer at heart. You're comfortable writing the example code, starter apps, and cookbooks that developers actually run.

  • Strong content instincts. You can turn a model launch into a demo, thread, or video that makes people want to try it, the same day.

  • Fluency in the communities where media and creative builders gather, and a feel for what they care about.

  • Comfortable being publicly visible as a representative of OpenRouter.

  • Self-directed and fast-moving. You define problems, find leverage, and ship independently.

Nice to Haves

  • A track record of engaging publicly, such as an active following on X, YouTube, or in developer communities.

  • A strong portfolio of demos, apps, or creative projects built with image, video, or audio models.

  • Past DevRel work at events or on camera, such as videos of you explaining a product or API.

  • Ability to travel for community events and meetups.

Why OpenRouter

  • Work at the center of the AI infrastructure stack as enterprises define how they adopt AI models.

  • High ownership and autonomy to define how OpenRouter shows up for multimodal builders.

  • Opportunity to shape a foundational function at a fast-growing company.

  • Fully remote team with a culture of autonomy and trust.

  • Competitive compensation, including base salary and equity.

If you don't meet every criterion but are excited about this role, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.
